_note: DRAFT Policy Compiler accuracy cases, written by Claude. The owner reviews each case, fixes or deletes any wrong expected answer, adds their own cases, and then moves this file to crash_lab/expected/compiler_cases.json by hand. run_compiler_eval.py only reads the expected/ copy.
_how_to_add_a_case: Copy any case and give it a new id. author: who wrote it (use "owner" for yours). style: "clean" or "messy". expected.result is compiled, needs_clarification, or cannot_enforce. For compiled, also give rule_type, settings (amounts as plain numbers), and action (ESCALATE or BLOCK). For the other two results, only the result is graded. notes is optional.
_graded_against: Policy version 1 (data/policies.json). A case that repeats a live rule is expected to be cannot_enforce, because code refuses duplicates.
